blends.name: The Green Sage – The Guardian of Growth
blends.desc:
Rooted in wisdom and flourishing with the energy of life, The Green Sage is a powerful and serene presence in the tooth realm. With a glowing aura of vibrant green, he represents renewal, growth, and the endless pursuit of knowledge. His connection to nature grants him abilities that rejuvenate his allies and overwhelm his foes with the unstoppable force of life itself.

The Green Sage is more than just a warrior—he’s a guide, offering wisdom and balance to those who seek it. As a Wisdom Tooth, his strength is unparalleled, anchoring his team with both power and insight.

Primary Class: Wisdom Tooth
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Nature Guardian
Position:* Wisdom Tooth Only (Tooth Numbers: #1, #16, #17, #32)

blends.name: The Blue Sage – The Keeper of Serenity
blends.desc:
The Blue Sage – The Keeper of Serenity

Radiating a tranquil yet powerful aura, The Blue Sage is the embodiment of calm amidst chaos. His deep blue glow soothes allies, restoring their focus and energy, while his piercing strikes cut through even the strongest defenses. Guided by the wisdom of water, he flows effortlessly between roles, adapting to the needs of the battlefield with unmatched precision.

Though his demeanor is calm, The Blue Sage’s strength lies in his unwavering resolve. As a Wisdom Tooth, he brings balance and harmony to his team, ensuring that every move leads to victory. His presence is a reminder that true power lies in clarity and control.

Primary Class: Wisdom Tooth
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Wave Guardian
Position:* Wisdom Tooth Only (Tooth Numbers: #1, #16, #17, #32)

blends.name: The Amber Sage – The Keeper of Flame and Earth
blends.desc:
Radiating with the warm glow of amber, The Amber Sage stands as a beacon of strength and wisdom. He draws power from the heart of the earth, channeling its molten energy to fortify allies and devastate enemies. His connection to both flame and soil symbolizes creation and destruction in perfect harmony, making him an anchor in the chaos of battle.

The Amber Sage’s calm demeanor masks an unrelenting resolve. As a Wisdom Tooth, he brings balance, endurance, and unyielding power to the team, ensuring that the tooth realm stands strong in the face of adversity.

Primary Class: Wisdom Tooth
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Earthen Warden
Position:* Wisdom Tooth Only (Tooth Numbers: #1, #16, #17, #32)

blends.name: Robin of Toothwood – The Dental Outlaw
blends.desc:
A hero of the tooth realm’s downtrodden, Robin of Toothwood fights with cunning, skill, and a heart full of justice. Clad in forest green and armed with his trusty bow, he strikes from the shadows, taking down foes with precision and redistributing their ill-gotten gains to the dental poor.

Robin’s sharp wit and sharper aim make him an invaluable ally in any fight, using strategy and quick thinking to outmaneuver even the most formidable enemies. Whether he’s protecting his team or rallying them with his unwavering courage, Robin of Toothwood is the champion of the people—and the scourge of decay.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Outlaw Archer
Position:* Frontline Scout (Tooth Numbers: #24, #25, #26, #23)

blends.name: Tooth Erikson – The Stormbreaker
blends.desc:
From the icy fjords of the north comes Tooth Erikson, a fierce and fearless Viking tooth who charges into battle with the power of the storm. Clad in rugged furs and wielding an axe as sharp as his bite, he thrives in the chaos of combat, breaking through enemy lines with unmatched ferocity. His war cries echo across the battlefield, rallying allies and striking fear into the hearts of foes.

Tooth Erikson isn’t just a warrior—he’s an explorer, charting new territories in the tooth realm with courage and determination. His strength and resilience make him a vital part of any team, as unyielding as the tides that carried his longship to distant shores.

Primary Class: Molar
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Berserker Raider
Position:* 1st or 2nd Molar (Tooth Numbers: #2, #3, #14, #15, #18, #19, #30, #31)

blends.name: Toothan the Eternal – The Wishing Tooth
blends.desc:
Summoned from the ancient sands of time, Toothan the Eternal is a mystical djinn tooth with the power to grant wishes—but always at a price. Cloaked in shimmering gold and swirling with ethereal smoke, Toothan’s presence is both mesmerizing and ominous. His true strength lies in his adaptability: with a single wish, he can take on any form, becoming the tooth his wielder needs most.

Though Toothan offers immense power, his bargains are rarely simple. Those who summon him must tread carefully, for his help often comes with unforeseen consequences. On the battlefield, Toothan’s ability to shift positions and roles makes him an invaluable wildcard, capable of turning the tide of any fight.

Primary Class: Wildcard (Any Tooth)
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Cosmic Trickster
Position:* Any Tooth (Tooth Numbers: Flexible)

blends.name: The Red Sage – The Flame of Fury
blends.desc:
Blazing with an unrelenting fire, The Red Sage embodies the destructive power of wisdom when unleashed. His crimson aura burns with intensity, channeling raw energy into devastating attacks that leave enemies scorched and trembling. Though his flames are fierce, they are controlled by his deep understanding of balance—fire destroys, but it also forges.

The Red Sage stands as a symbol of transformation and unyielding strength. As a Wisdom Tooth, his presence on the battlefield ignites his allies’ courage while consuming his enemies in a blaze of righteous fury.

Primary Class: Wisdom Tooth
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Inferno Warden
Position:* Wisdom Tooth Only (Tooth Numbers: #1, #16, #17, #32)

blends.name: XJ1C* – The Celestial Wanderer
blends.desc:
From the farthest reaches of the cosmos, XJ1C* arrives as an enigmatic force of both wonder and destruction. With a shimmering metallic body and glowing patterns etched like constellations, he carries the knowledge of galaxies unknown. His advanced alien technology gives him an edge no earthly tooth could match, allowing him to manipulate energy and matter with precision and grace.

Though his motives remain shrouded in mystery, XJ1C* fights with an undeniable purpose, balancing the wisdom of countless worlds with a warrior’s instinct. His presence on the battlefield is nothing short of cosmic—a being who transcends space and time to protect or obliterate as needed.

blends.name: Molaris Maximus – The Roman Crusher
blends.desc:
With the weight of an empire on his shoulders, Molaris Maximus stands as an unshakable bastion of strength and honor. Clad in ornate Roman armor and wielding a mighty gladius, he crushes his enemies with the precision and might of a seasoned legionnaire. Every move he makes is calculated, disciplined, and devastating.

Molaris Maximus doesn’t just fight for himself—he fights for the glory of the tooth realm and the legacy of those who came before him. As a steadfast 2nd molar, his position on the battlefield is critical, providing both strength and stability to his team. His unwavering loyalty and unbreakable resolve make him a cornerstone of any formation.

Primary Class: Molar
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Legion Commander
Position:* 2nd Molar (Tooth Numbers: #2, #15, #18, #31)

blends.name: Chief T’namel – The Tribal Protector
blends.desc:
Wise, steadfast, and deeply connected to the spirit of the tooth realm, Chief T’namel leads with both strength and compassion. Adorned in ceremonial headdress and wielding the wisdom of generations, he protects his people and their sacred lands with unyielding resolve. His bite is as fierce as his heart is strong, delivering crushing blows to any who threaten his tribe’s harmony.

Chief T’namel’s strength isn’t just physical—it’s spiritual. He channels the energy of his ancestors, guiding his team to victory through wisdom and unity. Whether defending his allies or rallying them with his battle cry, Chief T’namel embodies the essence of leadership.

Primary Class: Molar
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Spirit Guardian
Position:* Frontline Defender (1st or 2nd Molar)

blends.name: Sheriff Chewster Cogburn – The Frontier Hero
blends.desc:
With his badge polished and his boots firmly planted, Sheriff Chewster Cogburn is the embodiment of frontier justice. Armed with an unshakable sense of duty and a steady hand, he brings law and order to even the wildest of battles. Chewster’s grit and determination make him a true hero of the tooth realm, always ready to protect his allies and stand up against any threat.

Though he’s a man of few words, his actions speak volumes. Sheriff Chewster’s unwavering courage and sharp aim ensure that no enemy escapes the long arm of justice.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Lawman Defender
Position:* Top Central Incisor (#8 or #9)

blends.name: Deadeye Denny – The Likable Heel
blends.desc:
Clad in black and armed with a silver tongue, Deadeye Denny struts onto the battlefield with charm and a mischievous grin. He may be a heel, but there’s something undeniably magnetic about his roguish style and quick-draw precision. Denny doesn’t play by the rules—he bends them to his will, taking down foes with cunning and deadly accuracy.

Though his motives may be questionable, Deadeye Denny has a knack for showing up when it matters most. With his trademark wit and a twinkle in his eye, this outlaw is as unpredictable as a loaded six-shooter.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Outlaw Strategist
Position:* Top Central Incisor (#8 or #9)

blends.name: Crownopatra – The Desert Conqueror
blends.desc:
Crownopatra – The Desert Conqueror

Rising from the sands of time, Crownopatra is a fierce and cunning molar who blends beauty with unparalleled strength. With her golden armor and an unyielding will, she commands the battlefield with sharp intellect and ruthless precision. Every strike she delivers is calculated to bring her enemies to their knees, securing victory for her allies.

Crownopatra isn’t just a queen—she’s a warrior who fights for the survival and glory of her people. Her presence on the battlefield turns the tide of war, proving that true power lies in both mind and might.

Primary Class: Molar
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Desert Tactician
Position:* Frontline Commander

blends.name: Bite of Arc – The Divine Defender
blends.desc:
Bite of Arc – The Divine Defender

Chosen by fate and guided by a radiant vision, Bite of Arc is a fearless warrior tooth who fights with unwavering faith and conviction. Clad in gleaming armor and wielding a sword of light, she leads her allies into battle with both strength and inspiration. Her presence on the battlefield is nothing short of divine, rallying the forces of good against the darkness of decay.

Though her path is fraught with trials, Bite of Arc’s resolve never falters. She doesn’t just fight for victory—she fights for honor, justice, and the hope of a brighter tomorrow. With her unwavering courage, she’s a shining beacon for all who stand beside her.

Primary Class: Molar
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Holy Avenger
Position:* Frontline Crusader

blends.name: Cobalt Bite – The Steadfast Defender
blends.desc:
Standing side by side with his crimson counterpart, Cobalt Bite is a stalwart protector on the battlefield. Clad in shimmering blue armor, he represents calm precision and unshakable focus. While others charge ahead, Cobalt Bite holds the line, ensuring no ally is left unguarded.

His strength lies in his balance—unyielding in defense and efficient in offense. With every bite, he carves out victory with calculated precision. Together with his brother-in-arms, Crimson Cuspid, Cobalt Bite forms the unbreakable front of the NFTeeth forces.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class : Resolute Guardian
Position:* Frontline Central Incisor
Tooth Numbers:*
	•	#24: Bottom left central incisor.
	•	#25: Bottom right central incisor.

blends.name: Crimson Cuspid – The Fearless Vanguard
blends.desc:
Sharp, strong, and always ready for battle, Crimson Cuspid stands at the very frontlines, leading with courage and tenacity. His blood-red armor reflects both his fiery spirit and unyielding determination to protect his allies. As a soldier of unmatched resolve, he thrives under pressure, tearing through obstacles with precision and strength.

Crimson Cuspid doesn’t just fight—he inspires. His presence on the battlefield ignites the will of those around him, reminding his team that victory is born from unity and bravery.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Heroic Vanguard
Position:* Frontline Central Incisor
Tooth Numbers:*
	•	#24: Bottom left central incisor.
	•	#25: Bottom right central incisor.

blends.name: Jade Bite – The Emerald Sentinel
blends.desc:
With a sharp edge and a disciplined demeanor, Jade Bite marches into battle as a loyal defender of his squad. Clad in his signature green armor, he stands as a symbol of courage and precision, ready to protect his team and strike with calculated force. Jade Bite brings unwavering determination to the frontlines, ensuring victory through teamwork and strategy.

Though he shares the same position as Solar Root, Jade Bite’s unique tactical mind and emerald presence make him a vital part of the battlefield. His focus isn’t just on winning—it’s on ensuring his team stands strong no matter the odds.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class:* Tactical Soldier
Position:* Frontline Side Incisor (#23 or #26)

blends.name: Solar Root – The Radiant Protector
blends.desc:
A steadfast and noble warrior, Solar Root stands tall as a symbol of resilience and honor. As one of the side incisors, he brings strength and stability to the frontlines, shielding his allies while delivering precise strikes. With his gleaming armor and unshakable resolve, Solar Root represents the enduring spirit of those who have fought for justice and freedom.

His nickname comes from his radiant presence—a guiding light for his comrades in the darkest of battles. Solar Root doesn’t just fight for himself; he fights for those who can no longer stand and for the brighter future his team defends.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class:* Defender of Honor
Position:* Frontline Side Incisor #23 or #26

blends.name: Chomper Jack – The Frosty Frontiersman Fur Chomper
blends.desc:
Chomper Jack – The Frosty Frontiersman

Straight from the snowy wilderness, Chomper Jack is a rugged and resourceful tooth with a sharp edge—both in his bite and his wit. As a seasoned fur trapper, he uses his precision and cunning to survive the harshest conditions, striking swiftly and decisively when the moment calls for it. His tools of the trade—a sturdy hatchet and boundless grit—make him an invaluable ally.

While primarily an incisive scout with a knack for quick maneuvers, Chomper Jack’s resilience allows him to hold his ground as a third molar when the team needs a solid defender. His adaptability and frostbitten charm bring a unique edge to any battle.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Third Molar Defender
Position: Scout/Tank Hybrid

blends.name: Shogun Smiles – The Blade of Honor
blends.desc:
Shogun Smiles – The Blade of Honor

With discipline as sharp as his blade, Shogun Smiles is an incisive tooth who fights for honor, tradition, and balance. A master of the art of dental swordsmanship, his strikes are swift, precise, and devastating. Shogun Smiles leads with dignity, his polished edge reflecting the values of his ancient code.

Though a fierce warrior, Shogun Smiles values wisdom and strategy, believing that every battle is won first in the mind. His loyalty to his allies is unwavering, and his presence on the battlefield inspires both fear in his foes and courage in his comrades.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Blade Master
Position: Frontline Scout/Strategist

blends.name: Molarok – The Primal Crusher
blends.desc:
From the dawn of dental time comes Molarok, a caveman tooth with strength as raw and unyielding as the stone age itself. With his club-like build and unbreakable resolve, Molarok smashes through obstacles with brute force and primal instinct. His battle cry shakes the battlefield, and his crushing strikes leave opponents quaking.

Though simple in nature, Molarok’s loyalty and determination make him a dependable ally. He’s a protector of his clan, using his raw power to shield his team and dominate the frontlines. In a world of evolving teeth, Molarok proves that sometimes, the old ways are the best.

Primary Class: Primal Molar
Secondary Class  Primal Tank
Position: Frontline Crusher

blends.name: Anne Chompy – The Swashbuckling Incisor
blends.desc:
Anne Chompy – The Swashbuckling Incisor

A daring pirate with a sharp edge and an even sharper wit, Anne Chompy rules the high seas of the tooth realm. With her trusty cutlass and a mischievous grin, she carves her own path, seeking treasure and adventure at every turn. Anne’s speed and cunning make her a formidable foe, outmaneuvering her enemies with clever tactics and daring strikes.

Though her heart belongs to the thrill of the hunt, Anne Chompy is loyal to her crew and fights fiercely to protect those who stand by her side. Her incisive strikes and fearless attitude make her a vital part of any team—and she always gets the last laugh.

Primary Class: Incisor
Secondary Class Rogue Buccaneer

blends.name: Sir Bitesalot – The Gallant
blends.desc:
Sir Bitesalot – The Gallant 

With a gleaming suit of armor and a toothy grin, Sir Bitesalot charges into battle with boundless enthusiasm and an unshakable belief in doing what’s right—even if his plans are more silly than strategic. This White Knight Tooth is a beacon of optimism and loyalty, always ready to protect his allies with comedic flair and surprising bravery.

Though he may not always get it right, Sir Bitesalot’s heart is pure, and his determination knows no bounds. Whether fending off plaque dragons or jousting with cavities, he’s the knight in shining enamel you didn’t know you needed.

Primary Class: Canine
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Heroic Knight
Position: Frontline Leader

blends.name: The Dark Knight - Ebonbite
blends.desc:
Shrouded in mystery and clad in obsidian armor, Ebonbite is the enigmatic Black Knight Tooth. A brooding warrior of the shadows, he thrives in the darkness, using his stealth and cunning to outmaneuver foes. Ebonbite’s blade strikes with deadly precision, and his cold demeanor hides a deep sense of honor and loyalty.

Though feared by many, Ebonbite fights not for chaos but for justice on his own terms. His shadowy presence inspires both fear and respect, making him an invaluable ally—or a nightmare for those who cross him.

Primary Class: Molar (Tank)
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Shadow Knight
Position: Frontline Defender

blends.name: Tooth Lee – The Master of No Style
blends.desc:
Tooth Lee – The Master of No Style

Unpredictable, adaptable, and always a step ahead, Tooth Lee embodies the Style of No Style—a philosophy that allows him to seamlessly fit into any position on the battlefield. His fluid movements and unparalleled precision make him a versatile warrior, capable of striking hard as a frontline fighter or supporting allies with wisdom and strategy.

Tooth Lee’s mastery isn’t just about power—it’s about balance, adaptability, and knowing how to use every position to his advantage. Whether as a nimble incisor, a steadfast molar, or even a guiding Wisdom Tooth, Tooth Lee’s presence transforms any team into an unstoppable force.

Primary Class: Wildcard (Any Position)
Secondary Class (Upgradeable):* Master Strategist
Position: Flexible (Frontline, Support, or Specialist)

blends.name: Choppa Zulu – The Indomitable Warrior
blends.desc:
Choppa Zulu – The Indomitable Warrior

Standing tall as a symbol of unyielding strength and tradition, Choppa Zulu is a 1st molar built to withstand any challenge. His massive frame and impenetrable defenses make him the ultimate tank, holding the frontlines against overwhelming odds. With each swing of his tribal blade, he carves through opponents while rallying his allies to fight with honor and unity.

Choppa Zulu’s wisdom and strength give him versatility—able to stand firm as a 1st molar or ascend to a higher calling as a Wisdom Tooth, where his leadership shines even brighter. He’s not just a fighter; he’s a guardian of his people, carrying their legacy with every crushing blow.

Primary Class: Molar
Secondary Class (Upgradeable): Wisdom Guardian
Position: Frontline Tank

blends.name: Xenamel – Warrior Tooth Princess
blends.desc:
Xenamel – Warrior Tooth Princess

With her iconic battle stance and gleaming armor, Xenamel is a fierce and graceful warrior who fights with the strength of a thousand battles behind her. As the rightful princess of a distant enamel kingdom, she wields her legendary blade with precision and honor, protecting her realm from decay and darkness.

Xenamel’s resilience and unmatched combat skills make her a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. Her radiant presence inspires allies and strikes fear into the hearts of her foes. She isn’t just a princess—she’s a warrior destined to reshape the future of the tooth realms.

blends.name: MEGABite – The Cybernetic Crusher
blends.desc:
Mega-Bite – The Cybernetic Crusher

Forged in the smelting pits of a high-tech dystopia, Mega-Bite is a relentless robotic molar designed for destruction and precision. With gears that never stop turning and a mind sharper than steel, Giga-Bite doesn’t just crush his enemies—he out-thinks them, calculating every move with machine-like efficiency.

His glowing eyes and sleek metallic finish make him a marvel of engineering, while his titanium bite delivers crushing power that can pulverize even the toughest foes. Giga-Bite is more than just a machine—he’s a symbol of the future, where intelligence and strength unite.

Primary Class: Molar

blends.name: Chewdicca – Warrior Tooth Queen
blends.desc:
Chewdicca – Warrior Tooth Queen

Rising from the ashes of her conquered tribe, Chewdicca is a fearless warrior tooth who leads with unyielding strength and fiery resolve. She channels the spirit of rebellion, wielding her blade to crush the forces of plaque tyranny and restore honor to her kingdom.

With her regal crown and battle-scarred armor, Chewdicca strikes fear into her enemies and inspires loyalty among her allies. Her war cries echo through the battlefield, rallying those who fight for freedom and justice. A true leader, she fights not for herself but for the future of all teeth.

Primary Class: Molar

blends.name: Lon Fangey – The Lycan Incisor
blends.desc:
Lon Fangey – The Lycan Incisor

In the dead of night, when the moonlight spills across the battlefield, Lon Fangey prowls, an incisive tooth with a deadly secret. Transformed by a mysterious curse, he combines razor-sharp precision with the savage power of the wolf. Quick, relentless, and cunning, Lon Fangey tears through his foes with speed and precision, leaving nothing but chaos in his wake.

Though bound by the beast within, Lon Fangey retains a shred of his former self, a strategist who uses his lycanthropic instincts to outwit even the most formidable opponents. Beware his howl—it doesn’t just chill the air; it signals the end for his enemies.

Primary Class: Incisor

blends.name: Crite – The Alien Canin
blends.desc:
Crite – The Alien Canine

From the darkest corners of the galaxy comes Crite, a ferocious alien canine tooth with a voracious appetite for chaos. His razor-sharp fangs are perfect for tearing through enemies, leaving a trail of destruction in his wake. Despite his small size, Crite’s ferocity knows no bounds, and his cunning intelligence makes him a dangerous adversary.

Legends speak of his insatiable hunger—not just for food, but for power. Crite thrives on mayhem, gaining strength from the chaos around him. Beware of his bite—it’s not just sharp, it’s otherworldly.

Primary Class: Canine
Secondary Class (Upgradeable): Alien Monster
Position: Frontline Berserker

blends.name: Nikola Toothsla: Battle Tooth
blends.desc:
“Spark of Genius” Blend
Combine the raw brilliance of Nikola Toothsla with a dose of cosmic energy to create an electrifying evolution! This blend unleashes Nikola’s full potential, transforming him into a Tooth of unparalleled power. Harness his mastery over energy to dominate in battle and electrify the staking pool with increased rewards.
